name: Cosmic Darts
summary:
This is an adrenaline-filled VR Dart Throwing game that teleports you directly into the depths of the universe. The breathtaking vacuum of space replaces traditional dart halls; this is your new playground.

Your mission might seem simple at first glance: Your goal is to achieve the highest possible score within an intense 30-second period.

When you look through your virtual reality headset, a massive planet stands right in front of you. Next to this planet, there is also a satellite moving independently
